race.comment: MR BUBBALUSKI (1) goes on tip third-up, with his record here a good advantage. Has been left with too much ground to bridge in both runs back so far, so he should appreciate the added trip and Sandkuhl's 2kg claim gets him in well at the weights. POWER REECE (3) has the most appealing recent form, having run third in a BM65 at this track before an even fifth as favourite in a CL3 on the course proper. The return to this distance range suits. COASTAL COWBOY (2) is harder to line up first-up after eight months, but a close Gold Coast trial and his Grafton maiden win first-up last time in are strong form points. A bold return won't shock. HE IS THE KISS (6) was plain at Grafton, yet his third on the main track the start prior reads well and he is already a winner at this track and trip. Form is patchy but he deserves consideration.
